name: kody-os
_comment: Every field is optional; a missing file or broken JSON falls back to the stock look.
background: "desk" (default) or "paper", or a custom 8x8 grid object: {"grid": [r0..r7]} with eight integers 0-255, MSB leftmost, drawn black on paper as a repeating tile.
icon: a short text glyph ("OS") or a sanitized inline SVG string; empty keeps the default Kody mark (public/favicon.png).
Example icon: "icon": "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 16 16'><path d='M2 14L14 2' fill='none' stroke='#000'/></svg>"
Invalid grids or SVG fall back to the default background or Kody mark.
